limitations: API filters apply to end_date, not release date.
Candidate party is absent from answer objects and must be verified independently.
created_at is provider metadata and is not documented as primary release date.
Sample sizes and population metadata require source verification.
Internal, partisan and sponsor flags are source metadata, not independent verification.
Overlapping questions, duplicate syndications and leaned-voter variants require survey clustering.
Feed snapshot is not a comprehensive ballot roster and does not justify chamber-control forecasts.
API documentation was readable through web retrieval; direct shell retrieval returned HTTP403, so no raw documentation HTML was archived.
